recipes.name: Garden salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine or 6 cups (about 200 g) mixed greens
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon salt, pinch of pepper
steps: Wash the lettuce and dry it well in a salad spinner or towel.
Tear the lettuce into bite size pieces in a big bowl.
Slice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Add the cucumber, tomatoes, carrot and onion.
Shake the dressing ingredients in a jar with the lid on.
Toss the salad with the dressing just before serving and top with croutons.

recipes.name: Greek salad
ingredients: 1 cucumber, cut in thick half moons
4 oz (115 g) feta, in a block or crumbled
steps: Have an adult help cut the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and onion.
Put the vegetables and olives in a big bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar and sprinkle with salt.
Toss gently.
Put the feta on top and sprinkle with oregano.

recipes.name: Caprese salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon flaky salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella about 1/4 inch thick. Ask an adult to help.
Lay them on a plate, overlapping and switching between tomato and cheese.
Tuck basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Cobb salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled blue cheese or cheddar
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/4 teaspoon salt
steps: Spread the lettuce on a big platter.
Lay the chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomatoes and cheese on top in neat rows.
Shake the dressing in a jar.
Drizzle over the salad, or serve it on the side.

recipes.name: Classic potato salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) Yukon Gold or red potatoes, cut in 1 inch cubes
1 tablespoon pickle relish or chopped pickles
1/2 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Boil for 10 to 12 minutes, until a fork slides in easily but they hold their shape.
Drain and let cool for 20 minutes.
Stir the mayo, mustard, relish, vinegar, salt and pepper in a big bowl.
Add the potatoes, celery, green onions and eggs and fold gently.
Chill for 1 hour. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.name: German potato salad
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) small red potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 to 12 minutes, until just tender. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Cook the bacon in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat for 4 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the vinegar, water, sugar, mustard and salt and simmer for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and bacon and toss gently.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve warm.

recipes.name: Macaroni salad
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water following the package, plus 1 minute so it is soft. Ask an adult to help drain it.
Rinse with cold water and drain well.
Whisk the mayo, vinegar, sugar, mustard and salt in a big bowl.
Stir in the macaroni, celery, carrot, pepper and green onions.
Chill for 1 hour. Stir in a spoonful of milk if it gets dry.

recipes.name: Italian pasta salad
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) mozzarella pearls or cubes
Dressing: 1/2 cup (120 ml) olive oil, 1/4 cup (60 ml) red wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water following the package. Ask an adult to help drain it.
Rinse with cold water and drain well.
Shake the dressing ingredients in a jar.
Toss the pasta with the vegetables, olives, salami and mozzarella.
Pour on the dressing and toss.
Chill for 1 hour. Sprinkle with parmesan before serving.

recipes.name: Creamy coleslaw
ingredients: 6 cups (about 450 g) shredded green cabbage, or a 14 oz bag of coleslaw mix
steps: Whisk the mayo, vinegar, sugar, mustard, celery seed and salt in a big bowl.
Add the cabbage and carrot and toss well.
Chill for 30 minutes so it softens a little.

recipes.name: Asian sesame slaw
ingredients: 4 cups (about 300 g) shredded napa or green cabbage
Dressing: 3 tablespoons rice vinegar, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Put the cabbages, carrot, pepper, green onions and cilantro in a big bowl.
Whisk the dressing ingredients.
Pour over the slaw and toss.
Top with peanuts and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Broccoli salad
ingredients: 6 cups (about 450 g) small raw broccoli florets
1/2 cup (75 g) raisins or dried cranberries
Dressing: 3/4 cup (170 g) mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
steps: Cut the broccoli into very small florets.
Whisk the dressing in a big bowl.
Add the broccoli, bacon, cheese, raisins, onion and sunflower seeds and toss.
Chill for 1 hour so the flavors blend.

recipes.name: Creamy cucumber dill salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 g) sour cream or Greek yogurt
steps: Toss the cucumber slices with the salt in a strainer and let drain for 20 minutes.
Pat them dry with a towel.
Stir the sour cream, vinegar, sugar and dill in a bowl.
Add the cucumbers and onion and toss.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Smashed cucumber salad
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or black vinegar
steps: Lay a cucumber on a cutting board and press down hard with the flat side of a big knife or a rolling pin until it cracks. Ask an adult to help.
Break it into bite size chunks. Do the same with the other one.
Toss with the salt and sugar and let sit for 10 minutes, then pour off the water.
Stir the garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and chili oil.
Toss with the cucumbers and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 3 bunches flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped (about 3 cups)
steps: Pour the boiling water over the bulgur, cover and let sit for 20 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
Fluff it with a fork and let cool.
Have an adult help finely chop the parsley, mint and tomatoes.
Mix everything in a big bowl.
Taste and add more lemon or salt. It should taste bright and lemony.

recipes.name: Fattoush
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil for the pita
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 small garlic clove, grated, 1 teaspoon sumac, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the pita pieces with oil and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp.
Put the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, radishes, green onions and herbs in a big bowl.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the salad with the dressing, then add the crispy pita and toss again.
Sprinkle with more sumac.

recipes.name: Mediterranean quinoa salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Simmer the quinoa in the water, covered, for 15 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Let sit for 5 minutes, fluff and spread on a plate to cool for 15 minutes.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the quinoa with the cucumber, tomatoes, chickpeas, olives and parsley.
Pour on the dressing and fold in the feta.

recipes.name: Three bean salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) cut green beans, drained
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/3 cup (80 ml) apple cider vinegar, 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Whisk the dressing until the sugar dissolves.
Put the beans, chickpeas, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Pour on the dressing and stir.
Chill for 1 hour, stirring once.

recipes.name: Waldorf salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup (55 g) walnuts, toasted and chopped
steps: Toss the apples with the lemon juice so they stay white.
Stir the mayo and yogurt in a bowl.
Add the apples, celery, grapes and walnuts and fold together.
Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Ambrosia salad
ingredients: 1 can (11 oz / 312 g) mandarin oranges, drained
1 can (8 oz / 227 g) pineapple tidbits, drained
1 cup (240 g) sour cream or whipped topping
steps: Drain the fruit well.
Stir everything together in a bowl.
Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.name: Watermelon feta salad
steps: Put the watermelon and cucumber in a big bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.
Toss gently.
Sprinkle with feta, mint and salt. Serve cold right away.

recipes.name: Strawberry spinach salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup (50 g) crumbled feta or goat cheese
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 teaspoon poppy seeds, pinch of salt
steps: Put the spinach in a big bowl and top with strawberries, almonds, cheese and onion.
Shake the dressing in a jar.
Drizzle over the salad just before serving.

recipes.name: Massaged kale salad
ingredients: 1 large bunch curly or lacinato kale
1/4 cup (35 g) toasted sunflower seeds or almonds
steps: Pull the kale leaves off the stems and tear or slice them thin.
Put the kale in a bowl with the oil, lemon juice, honey and salt.
Squeeze and rub the kale with your hands for 2 minutes, until it turns darker and softer.
Toss in the parmesan, cranberries and seeds.

recipes.name: Wedge salad
ingredients: Dressing: 1/2 cup (120 g) sour cream, 1/4 cup (60 g) mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons milk, 1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled blue cheese, 1 teaspoon lemon juice, pinch of salt and pepper
steps: Stir the dressing ingredients, mashing some of the blue cheese.
Have an adult cut the lettuce into 4 wedges through the core.
Put each wedge on a plate.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges.
Top with bacon, tomatoes and green onions.

recipes.name: Taco salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained and rinsed
Sour cream and salsa to top
steps: Cook the beef in a pan over medium high heat for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink is left. Ask an adult to help.
Drain the fat, stir in the taco seasoning and water, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Put the lettuce in bowls and top with beef, tomatoes, beans and cheese.
Add crushed chips, sour cream and salsa just before eating.

recipes.name: Panzanella
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil for the bread
1 1/2 lb (680 g) ripe tomatoes, cut in chunks
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 small garlic clove, grated, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the bread with oil and bake for 10 minutes, until crisp at the edges.
Put the tomatoes, cucumber and onion in a big bowl with the salt from the dressing. Let sit for 10 minutes so the juice comes out.
Whisk the rest of the dressing.
Add the bread, dressing and basil and toss.
Let sit for 10 minutes so the bread soaks up the juices.

recipes.name: Thai mango salad
ingredients: 2 firm, slightly underripe mangoes, cut in thin strips
Dressing: 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 tablespoon fish sauce or soy sauce, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1/2 small chili, minced (optional)
steps: Have an adult peel and cut the mangoes into thin strips.
Stir the dressing until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the mango, pepper, onion, cilantro and mint with the dressing.
Top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Kachumber salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin or chaat masala
steps: Have an adult help dice the vegetables into small, even pieces.
Put everything in a bowl.
Toss and serve right away, so it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Lemony lentil salad
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) green or brown lentils, rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1 small garlic clove, grated, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Cover the lentils and bay leaf with 3 cups of water in a pot and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender but not mushy. Drain and take out the bay leaf.
Whisk the dressing and toss it with the warm lentils.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Stir in the carrot, onion, parsley and feta.

recipes.name: Lemon orzo salad
ingredients: Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Cook the orzo in salted boiling water following the package. Ask an adult to help drain it.
Rinse with cold water and drain well.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the orzo with the cucumber, tomatoes, spinach, herbs and dressing.
Fold in the feta.

recipes.name: Carrot raisin salad
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) carrots, peeled and shredded
1 can (8 oz / 227 g) crushed pineapple, drained
1/3 cup (75 g) mayonnaise or Greek yogurt
steps: Shred the carrots on a box grater, keeping your fingers away from the blades.
Stir the mayo, honey, lemon juice and salt in a bowl.
Add the carrots, raisins and pineapple and toss.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Summer corn salad
ingredients: 4 ears corn, or 3 cups (450 g) frozen corn, thawed
steps: Boil the corn ears for 4 minutes, let cool, and have an adult cut off the kernels. Frozen corn can skip this.
Put the corn, tomatoes, cucumber, onion and basil in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lime juice and sprinkle with salt.
Toss and serve.

recipes.name: Chinese chicken salad
ingredients: 4 cups (about 300 g) shredded napa cabbage or romaine
1 can (11 oz / 312 g) mandarin oranges, drained
1 cup crispy wonton strips or chow mein noodles
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) rice vinegar, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons honey, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Whisk the dressing.
Toss the chicken, cabbages, carrot and green onions with most of the dressing.
Top with mandarin oranges, almonds and wonton strips.
Drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

recipes.name: Avocado tomato salad
steps: Have an adult cut and pit the avocados.
Put the avocado, tomatoes, onion and cilantro in a bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Toss gently and eat right away.

recipes.name: Arugula parmesan salad
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon flaky salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put the arugula in a big bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Toss gently with your hands.
Top with parmesan and pine nuts. Serve right away.

recipes.name: Antipasto salad
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) salami, sliced into strips
1/2 cup jarred roasted red peppers, sliced
Dressing: 1/3 cup (80 ml) olive oil, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, 1/4 teaspoon salt
steps: Put the lettuce in a big bowl.
Add the salami, cheese, olives, peppers, artichokes, tomatoes and pepperoncini.
Shake the dressing in a jar.
Toss the salad with the dressing just before serving.

recipes.name: Sesame soba noodle salad
ingredients: Dressing: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Cook the soba in boiling water following the package, usually 4 to 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Drain and rinse under cold water, rubbing gently to wash off the starch.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and dressing.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Olivier salad
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) cooked ham or bologna, diced (optional)
steps: Boil the whole potatoes and carrots for 20 to 25 minutes, until a knife slides in. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool for 30 minutes.
Dice the potatoes, carrots, eggs and pickles into small cubes about the size of the peas.
Put everything in a big bowl with the peas and ham.
Fold in the mayo, salt and dill.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mediterranean chickpea salad
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Put the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the dressing.
Toss everything together and top with feta.

recipes.name: Beet and goat cheese salad
ingredients: 1 package (8 oz / 225 g) cooked peeled beets, cut in wedges
5 oz (140 g) mixed greens or arugula
1/4 cup (30 g) candied or toasted walnuts
Dressing: 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, 1 teaspoon honey, pinch of salt
steps: Shake the dressing in a jar.
Toss the greens with half the dressing and spread on a platter.
Add the beets. They stain everything pink, so add them last.
Top with goat cheese and walnuts and drizzle with the rest of the dressing.
